title: Trevor Requested Obsidian Sync via Terminal
description: Trevor requested opening Obsidian from terminal to trigger Obsidian Sync. Attempted but failed due to GUI display requirements in terminal-only environment.

title: Obsidian Sync Requires GUI
description: Obsidian Sync is a GUI-only feature requiring to desktop app to be running. No official headless sync CLI available for triggering sync without display.

title: obsidian-cli Evaluated - No Sync Support
description: Evaluated Yakitrak's obsidian-cli (GitHub: Yakitrak/obsidian-cli). Supports note operations (create, update, delete, search) but does NOT support sync. Requires Obsidian desktop app running for sync to function.

title: Sync Alternatives Identified
description: Identified alternatives to Obsidian Sync for headless/terminal sync: (1) Obsidian Git plugin - syncs vault to GitHub, (2) iCloud, Dropbox, or Syncthing - third-party sync for vault folder, (3) Syncthing or Resilio Sync - dedicated sync tools for background file sync.

title: Obsidian Second Brain Setup
description: Trevor uses Obsidian as Second Brain with GTD + PARA methodology. Vault path: /home/desktop/obsidian-second-brain. Using Obsidian Sync for cross-device synchronization.

title: OpenClaw Obsidian Sync Installed
description: Trevor installed OpenClaw plugin for two-way sync between Obsidian and Clawdbot. Plugin provides chat sidebar, file actions, and secure sync with token authentication.

title: Obsidian Sync Skill Created
description: Created obsidian-sync skill at /home/desktop/clawd/skills/obsidian-sync/ with secure file sync server running on port 18790. Uses token-based auth and path traversal protection.

title: Tailscale Serve for Secure Sync
description: Sync endpoint exposed via Tailscale serve (https://clawd-vps.tail8c6e6b.ts.net:18790) for tailnet-only access. All requests require Bearer token authentication.

title: Tailscale Serve Changed to Port 18790
description: Changed Tailscale serve configuration from port 443 to port 18790 per Trevor's request. Command: sudo tailscale serve --bg --https=18790 http://localhost:18790

title: Sync Uses Gateway Token
description: Changed sync server authentication to use same Gateway Token (e072fde4da4f16b77f4982d9dd830e39940fee01d59c8668) instead of separate sync token. Resolved 403 Forbidden error.

title: Correct Sync Path Identified
description: Identified correct remote sync path as 'openclaw/secondbrain' not just 'openclaw'. Files are nested one level deeper in the directory structure.

title: 335 Vault Files Confirmed
description: Confirmed 335 files in vault at /home/desktop/openclaw/secondbrain/ including 00-Dashboard.md, 01-Daily-Notes/, 02-Projects/, and more. Sync server verified working.

title: Sync Server Fully Operational
description: Sync server confirmed operational with Gateway Token authentication on port 18790. Server URL: https://clawd-vps.tail8c6e6b.ts.net:18790

title: Files Not Appearing Locally After Sync
description: User reported sync completes successfully but files don't appear in Obsidian vault locally. Configuration verified correct: remote path 'openclaw/secondbrain', local path '.', authentication working. Server has 335 files. Issue unresolved - may be files syncing to subfolder.
